market.question: Will the highest temperature in Karachi be 35°C on May 10?

assessment.reasoning: Karachi May 10 forecast shows highs around 33-34°C with patchy rain mentioned; Masroor airbase often runs slightly hotter than coastal Karachi. The 35°C bucket is just above the central forecast and reasonably plausible.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Airbase microclimate and exact diurnal peak
